title: Retrieval-augmented generation
text: Retrieval-augmented generation pairs a retriever with a generator. The retriever selects passages, and the generator answers from them.

title: BM25
text: BM25 ranks documents by term frequency and inverse document frequency, with parameters that control saturation and length normalisation.

title: Reciprocal rank fusion
text: Reciprocal rank fusion merges several ranked lists by summing one over k plus the rank of each document.
